title: Transcriptomics Reveals Cold Tolerance Maize Lines Involved in the Phenylpropanoid and Flavonoid Pathways
genotypes: AM (=J1898; cold-tolerant); CM (=J1218; cold-tolerant); BM (=PH4CV; cold-sensitive); inbreds from Jilin Agricultural University
growth_system: rolled germination paper incubated vertically at the treatment temperature; incubator type, light and photoperiod NR
timepoints_duration: single sampling at day 3 of germination at 6 °C or 25 °C
platform_layout: Illumina NovaSeq 6000, PE150, strand-specific (NEBNext Ultra II); >=20 M reads per sample
other_omics: physiology (germination rate, coleoptile length, MDA, SOD, POD); qRT-PCR validation
key_finding: Tolerant lines activate phenylpropanoid/flavonoid genes and peroxidase ZmPER5 at 6 °C; sensitive BM responds weakly.
source_of_details: PMC full text + Europe PMC full-text XML (data availability statement)
notes: Reads mapped to B73 v4 (HISAT2); upregulated DEGs: CM 1388, AM 690, BM 90; 320 genes shared by AM and CM only; accession taken from Data Availability Statement.

title: Evaluation of cold tolerance in maize diversity panel and transcriptome analysis of two extreme genotypes under cold stress
genotypes: By813 (cold-resistant, highest D value); CML454 (cold-sensitive, lowest D value); both chosen from a 205-genotype panel for RNA-seq
tissue: NR (seedling; tissue not stated in abstract)
other_factors: tolerant vs sensitive genotypes selected from diversity panel
other_omics: physiology (REC, plant height, root length, shoot FW and DW) in 205 genotypes; qRT-PCR of 10 DEGs
key_finding: By813 vs CML454 differ by 10,682 DEGs at 28 °C and 8,852 at 4 °C; flavonoid and hormone pathways enriched.
source_of_details: abstract only (no PMC full text; web search found nothing)
notes: Abstract wording on DEGs is ambiguous (appears to be between-genotype DEGs at each temperature); design details and accession need the publisher page; keyword RNA-Seq confirms sequencing.

title: Integrated Transcriptome-Metabolome Analysis Reveals the Flavonoids Metabolism Mechanism of Maize Radicle in Response to Low Temperature
genotypes: ZD958 (Zhengdan958, dent); DMY1 (Demeiya1, flint); varieties grown in NE China cold regions; tolerance contrast not claimed
stage_age: germinated seeds: after 60 h germination at 25 °C, seedlings with uniform radicle length transferred to treatments
growth_system: paper-bed germination boxes / trays (10 mL sterile water), artificial climate chamber, darkness, RH 50 ± 5%
platform_layout: NR (Biomarker Technologies, Beijing; ~6.02 Gb clean data per sample)
other_omics: untargeted metabolomics (LC-MS); physiology (ROS, MDA, antioxidant enzymes, flavonoids)
key_finding: At 5 °C vs 15 °C both varieties upregulate phenylpropanoid, flavonoid and isoflavonoid pathways in radicles.
notes: Control is 15 °C (not 25 °C); reads mapped to B73 v4 with HISAT2; DEGs 4,894 (ZD958) and 5,301 (DMY1).

title: Differential cold stress intensities drive unique morphological and transcriptomic changes in Zea mays root hairs
tissue: root hairs of primary root (dislodged in liquid N2; pooled ~120-150 seedlings per replicate)
stage_age: 3-day-old seedlings (3 d germination at control, then 24 h treatment)
growth_system: germination paper rolls in buckets with distilled water, Conviron growth cabinets, 16 h light/8 h dark
cold_treatments: mild cold 16/12 °C day/night; severe cold 10/6 °C day/night
platform_layout: Illumina NovaSeq X Plus, PE150 (Novogene, Cambridge UK)
key_finding: Mild cold gave 3,401 DEGs (mostly down); severe cold 5,316 DEGs with broader stress, hormone and peroxidase responses.
notes: Aligned to Zm-B73-REFERENCE-NAM-5.0 with CLC Genomics Workbench; DESeq2 in R; a 24 h severe-cold then control recovery experiment was phenotype only (no RNA-seq).

title: Brassinosteroids Enhance Low-Temperature Resistance by Promoting the Formation of Sugars in Maize Mesocotyls
genotypes: Zheng58 (Reid group inbred); seeds produced at Longxi station, Gansu
stage_age: etiolated seedlings: 5 d at 25 °C in darkness after sowing, then 5 d treatment
growth_system: pots (17 cm high, 20 cm diameter) with vermiculite, 10 seeds per pot, illumination incubator, darkness
cold_treatments: 10 °C, with 0 µM EBR (LT) or 2.0 µM EBR (LTE)
control_temperature: 25 °C, with 0 µM EBR (CK) or 2.0 µM EBR (CKE)
platform_layout: Results: Illumina NovaSeq PE150; Methods: BGI DNBSEQ-T7 (Shanghai Personal Biotechnology) - inconsistent in paper
key_finding: 10 °C changes starch/sucrose and glycolysis genes in mesocotyls; EBR dampens several LT-induced expression changes.
source_of_details: PMC full text (no data availability statement in retrieved text)
notes: Reads mapped to B73 v4 (HISAT2, HTSeq, DESeq); no accession seen in retrieved text, data statement may exist on publisher page.

title: Functional Analysis of Zinc Finger Protein Transcription Factor ZmZFP69 Under Low-Temperature Stress at Maize Seedling Stage
genotypes: B73 (control); zmzfp69 homozygous mutant (127-bp deletion, premature stop; background and origin NR)
growth_system: light incubator, 25 °C, 16 h light/8 h dark before treatment; cold in light incubator
cold_treatments: 4 °C (48 h continuous for phenotype/survival, then 24 h recovery at 25 °C; RNA-seq at 0 and 24 h, or 0, 24 and 48 h)
timepoints_duration: RNA-seq 0 h and 24 h (Results) or 0, 24 and 48 h (Methods); inconsistent in paper
platform_layout: Illumina (Novogene, Beijing), strand-specific paired-end; RNA-seq read length NR (DAP-seq was NovaSeq 6000 PE150)
key_finding: zmzfp69 mutant is more cold tolerant; ZmZFP69 represses ZmAOX2; 594 DEGs mutant vs control.
source_of_details: PMC full text (no data availability statement in retrieved text)
notes: Sampling times inconsistent in text (0/24 h vs 0/24/48 h); total 295,953,316 reads reported; reads aligned to B73 v4 (HISAT2).

title: Mechanisms of Exogenous Brassinosteroids and Abscisic Acid in Regulating Maize Cold Stress Tolerance
tissue: leaf (collar tissue of the second leaf)
growth_system: climate chambers, sterilized perlite in nutrient pots, 12 h light/12 h dark, 600 µmol m-2 s-1, RH 60-80%
cold_treatments: 10 ± 1 °C for 7 d with water (LT), 5 mg/L ABA, 0.1 mg/L BR, or ABA+BR (AR) applied every 2 d
other_factors: exogenous ABA, BR, ABA+BR under cold
other_omics: physiology (growth, MDA, proline, antioxidant enzymes); WGCNA; qRT-PCR
key_finding: Cold gives 7,532 DEGs in Shen137; ABA or BR alone alleviate cold, combined AR does not.
source_of_details: PMC full text (no data availability statement in retrieved text)
notes: Text says 45 leaf samples = 15 pooled replicates; mapping 86-89% to B73 NAM v5; LH82 not sequenced.

title: Mining of co-expression genes in response to cold stress at maize (Zea mays L.) germination and sprouting stages by weighted gene co-expression networks analysis
tissue: germination stage: embryos dissected from germinating seeds; sprouting stage: whole sprouts (cut for sampling)
stage_age: germination stage (seeds soaked 12 h at 25 °C); sprouting stage (sprouts ~4 cm after germination at 25 °C)
growth_system: incubator, 24 h dark, 60% humidity; dishes with moist sponge and filter paper, 20 seeds per dish
other_factors: tolerant vs sensitive inbreds; two developmental stages
n_libraries: 60 (computed: 2 stages x 2 lines x 5 time points x 3 reps; text says 60 samples)
key_finding: WGCNA finds cold-linked modules (hormone, MAPK signalling) separating tolerant from sensitive lines over 36 h.
source_of_details: PMC full text (no data availability statement in retrieved text)
notes: Raw reads: 230.4 and 228.3 Gb for the two stages; 14,384/7,301 (germination R/S) and 10,295/10,799 (sprouting R/S) DEGs within 36 h; no accession seen.
